one_liner: Bo Bichette put 917 balls in play from only 2,224 pitches seen -- the most contact-dense profile among the hitters covered here.
three_things: 917 batted balls on 2,224 pitches: almost nothing goes to waste.
The contact grades well too -- .349 estimated wOBA at 84.7 mph average.
The 90th-percentile exit velocity, 103 mph, is solid rather than elite.
context_note: Descriptive only, from a single 2025 Statcast pull (pitches_faced_2025>=300 floor, 485 of 671 batters). The contact numbers -- exit velocity and estimated wOBA on contact -- cover the batted balls only, not every pitch seen, and estimated wOBA on contact is a batted-ball model: it says nothing about walks, strikeouts, or actual results. This pull carries no swing/miss or launch-angle column, so there is no whiff rate and no barrel profile here. Not park-, role-, or opponent-adjusted, and not a prediction. The contact-density comparison is scoped to the hitters with insight files in this set and is derived from two manifest fields rather than read from one.
